_what: Held-out Indonesian-voice eval, ITEMS v1 + RUBRIC v2. Items are unchanged from v1; the rubric was revised 2026-08-19 after product review found two false positives. Supersedes VOICE_EVAL_MANIFEST.v1.json.

threshold._verified: 38/40 passes and 37/40 fails, checked against the scorer.

gating._why: Per-dimension rates say WHERE a regression happened; a single number cannot.

_domains_disjoint_from.survey_corpus: banking and civil administration (blocking cards, OTP, Dukcapil, NPWP)
_domains_disjoint_from.training_corpus: procurement, access review, staff training programmes

_analysis.exact_reuse: 0 against all four corpora — no answer, user phrasing, or item is reused.
_analysis.token_overlap_is_not_reuse: Up to 0.90 against the promoted corpus, but that is shared common Indonesian vocabulary (berikut, bagian, dokumen, untuk, tidak), not shared content. Reported because the raw number looks alarming and would otherwise invite a wrong conclusion.
_analysis.phrase_overlap_8gram_full_prompt: 6/40 items — ALL instruction templates or document-format boilerplate ('terjemahkan teks berikut ke bahasa inggris pertahankan angka', 'memo internal kepada seluruh kepala bagian'). This sharing is DELIBERATE: the eval must use the product's real task instructions or it is not testing the product's tasks.
_analysis.phrase_overlap_8gram_content_only: 1/40 — the memo header layout only. No scenario, fact, figure, or answer is shared with any training or survey corpus.

_leakage_note: tantular_sft_aug.jsonl IS the 153-example corpus that trained tantular:0.2-id-3b-lora, and tantular_sft.jsonl its 17-example seed. Neither answer, user phrasing, nor paraphrase is reused here. Token overlap is common Indonesian vocabulary, not shared content — exact reuse is 0 against all four.

rubric.register: no informal address (Kak/kamu/lo), no greeting filler opening a document answer
rubric.terminology: generic anglicisms flagged where a standard term exists; established domain terms allow-listed; source-required terms exempt
rubric.language: Indonesian-dominant, except where the task asks for English

_no_model_judges_another: Every check is a deterministic string or ratio test.

rubric_v2_changes._why: Both are established in Indonesian office usage in a way setting/backup/user are not. Under rubric v1 they produced FALSE FAILURES on natural professional Indonesian ('Silakan unduh file laporan', 'Sistem melakukan update data'). Approved 2026-08-19.
rubric_v2_changes.di_update_note: `update` is allow-listed as an established NOUN; `di-update` stays denied as a mixed-affix VERB (Indonesian prefix, English root) whose standard form is `diperbarui`. Flagged at review rather than decided silently.
rubric_v2_changes.threshold: UNCHANGED at 0.95. The fix for a false positive is a correct list, not a lower bar. Re-verified: 38/40 PASS, 37/40 FAIL.

THIS_GATE_DOES_NOT_TEST_FAITHFULNESS: It checks voice only. A fabricated figure written in fluent professional Indonesian PASSES here. Faithfulness is covered by the mechanical checks in calibrate.py and by office_json_contract. A voice pass must never be read as a faithfulness pass. Recorded per review finding 2, 2026-08-19.

known_limitations.audience_coverage: Only 5 of 40 items name an audience in the instruction, so 35 test 'not casual' rather than 'correct for this reader'. ACCEPTED for v1; to be widened in the next eval version. Explicitly NOT a reason to loosen the current gate.
known_limitations.self_review: The items and rubric were drafted and reviewed by the same author. The findings are real; the absence of further findings carries less weight than independent review would.

test_evidence.behavioural_cases: 16/16 behaved as specified under rubric v2 — file/update pass; setting/backup/user/di-update/meeting/deadline/budget/approve fail; register and baku violations fail; source-exempt terms pass while an exempt answer with a register violation still fails.
test_evidence.threshold_boundary: 38/40 PASS, 37/40 FAIL, re-verified after the rubric change.
